A Windows tray app that keeps your chosen lighting on an sbarda keyboard. Tested on **ZORNER ZH99 HE** (`19F5:FB2A`). See the [README](https://github.com/lostintired/sbarda-kblight#readme) for installation instructions.

**To update from 1.3.0:** right-click the tray icon → Exit, replace `KbLight.exe`, then start it. Your lighting settings are preserved. Both lighting switches default to enabled, and quiet hours are disabled until you turn them on.

### What's new

- **Independent lighting switches.** Turn the keys and Light box off separately without losing their brightness, effect, mode or color. Turn a light back on to restore its saved settings. The Light box's existing Off mode continues to work.
- **Daily quiet hours.** Set a local-time interval to turn both lights off completely. The initial interval is **23:00–09:00**, with scheduling disabled by default. At the end, saved settings return; manually disabled lights stay off. You can edit daytime brightness while quiet hours are active.
- **Consistent scheduling.** Startup, keyboard connection, resume from sleep, and one-shot `--apply` / `--check` commands use the current Windows local time. Time-zone changes are detected without restarting. Scheduling requires the tray app to be running and never wakes the computer. If the settings file has no Light box profile yet, run the tray first: one-shot commands leave that light untouched.
- **Clearer status and a scrollable window.** Quiet hours and manually disabled lights have their own status messages. The settings window fits the screen and scrolls when needed, including at 150% and 200% display scaling. English and Russian are supported.
